subtopics.content: Hospitality industry/catering, types of establishments, culinary terms, safety precautions, sanitation and hygiene
subtopics.objective: Understand definitions and components of the hospitality industry; identify types and functions of catering establishments (hotels, restaurants, outdoor, mobile, institutional)[cite: 103, 104]; apply common culinary terms[cite: 104]; manage safety, first aid, and firefighting equipment[cite: 104]; execute personal, kitchen, environmental, and water hygiene practices[cite: 104].

topics.title: Food Commodities and Methods of Food Preparation

subtopics.content: Study of food commodities and principles of cooking methods
subtopics.objective: Understand food commodities (poultry, game, meat, fish, vegetables, fruits, dairy, pulses, cereals, herbs, flavourings)[cite: 104]; master cooking methods (boiling, roasting, grilling, baking)[cite: 104]; execute dish preparations and apply standard and local measurements[cite: 104].

subtopics.content: Food and beverage personnel, types of food service, alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, costing and control
subtopics.objective: Identify roles and functions of food/beverage personnel[cite: 105]; master table laying, covers, and service types (Gueridon, silver, waiter, buffet, banquet)[cite: 105]; understand bar operations and beverage classification[cite: 105]; apply portion control, sales calculation, and dish costing[cite: 105].

subtopics.content: Types of kitchen equipment, care, and maintenance
subtopics.objective: Identify types and uses of various large and small kitchen equipment[cite: 105]; apply proper cleaning, care, and routine maintenance techniques for kitchen equipment[cite: 105].

subtopics.content: Principles of menu planning, menu types, special menus, and accompaniments
subtopics.objective: Understand menu scope and factors affecting menu planning[cite: 105]; differentiate menu types (table d'hôte, à la carte, special occasion, breakfast, luncheon, dinner)[cite: 105]; plan meal plans for vegetarians, vulnerable groups, manual/sedentary workers[cite: 105, 106]; select appropriate food and table accompaniments[cite: 106].
